description: This file defines an Android Activity demonstrating usage of date and time picker widgets, including handling dialogs for selecting dates and times, updating display, and preserving state across configuration changes.

classes.name: DateWidgets1
classes.description: Main activity class for demonstrating date and time widgets, managing dialogs, and updating display text.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets layout, assigns click listeners to buttons, and initializes date/time variables.

methods.name: setDialogOnClickListener
methods.description: Helper method to assign click listeners to buttons that trigger dialogs.

methods.name: onCreateDialog
methods.description: Creates dialogs based on dialog ID, returning DatePicker or TimePicker dialogs.

methods.name: onPrepareDialog
methods.description: Prepares existing dialogs with current date/time before displaying.

methods.name: updateDisplay
methods.description: Updates the TextView to show current selected date and time.

methods.name: pad
methods.description: Utility method to format numbers with leading zero if less than 10.
